name: Internal Sale & Cogs
query: select `tabSales Invoice`.`company` AS 'From (company):350', Coalesce(`tabSales Invoice`.`customer`,'Total') AS 'Customer:Link/Customer:350', CONCAT('₹',FORMAT(round(sum(`tabSales Invoice Item`.`qty` * `tabSales Invoice Item`.`rate`)), 'c', 'en_IN')) AS 'Sales Amount::150', CONCAT('₹',FORMAT(round(sum(`tabSales Invoice Item`.`qty` * (`tabStock Ledger Entry`.`stock_value_difference`/`tabStock Ledger Entry`.`actual_qty`))), 'c', 'en_IN')) AS 'COGS::150', CONCAT('₹',FORMAT(round((sum(`tabSales Invoice Item`.`qty` * `tabSales Invoice Item`.`rate`)-sum(`tabSales Invoice Item`.`qty` * (`tabStock Ledger Entry`.`stock_value_difference`/`tabStock Ledger Entry`.`actual_qty`)))), 'c', 'en_IN')) AS 'Margin::150' from `tabSales Invoice Item`,`tabSales Invoice` LEFT OUTER JOIN `tabStock Ledger Entry` ON `tabStock Ledger Entry`.`voucher_no`=`tabSales Invoice`.`name` where (DATE(`tabSales Invoice`.`posting_date`) between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s) and `tabStock Ledger Entry`.`item_code`=`tabSales Invoice Item`.`item_code` and `tabSales Invoice`.`name`=`tabSales Invoice Item`.`parent` and `tabSales Invoice`.`customer` IN ('Capgrid Solutions Pvt Ltd-UK','CapGrid Solutions Pvt Ltd-Gujarat','CAPGRID SOLUTIONS PVT LTD-GURGAON','Capgrid Solutions Private Limited-Jaipur','CapGrid Solutions Pvt Ltd-Hosur') and `tabSales Invoice`.docstatus=1 group by `tabSales Invoice`.`customer` with rollup
